item.title: WATCH: Runners participate in NYC Marathon with a purpose
item.description: ABC News' Lara Spencer shares the story of "Team Inspire" as they prepare to run 26.2 miles across New York City.

item.title: Anthropic prepares for IPO in significant move for AI firm
item.description: Anthropic, the maker of the Claude chatbot, has been a leading player in AI development.

item.title: Trump directed DOJ to sue to block Alaska Senate results if Republican narrowly loses
item.description: President Trump said he instructed the DOJ to preemptively file a lawsuit to block certification of the Alaska Senate race if the Republican incumbent narrowly loses.

item.title: New poll reveals why Democrats, Republicans are voting in midterms
item.description: With the midterms days away, new polling indicates voters are motivated by specific issues. CBS News' Fin Gómez, Nancy Cordes and others report.
